**Orglet 0.2.11** for Windows.

If you run 0.2.4 or later from Setup, this update arrives by itself and is used the next time you start Orglet.

### The island is easier to see

The island above the message box and the message box itself now have an outline you can actually see, and a soft shadow that lifts them off the chat. The two read as one shape, with the line running only round the outside. Clicking into the message box still makes the line a step darker.

### Before you install

The installer is still not signed. Windows may say it protected your PC. If you downloaded Setup from this page, choose **More info → Run anyway**.

Orglet is open source under AGPL-3.0. This release ships for Windows only. Release checklist: [windows-release-gates.md](https://github.com/codepawl/orglet/blob/main/docs/windows-release-gates.md).
